verses.text: The heavens declare the glory of God. The expanse shows his handiwork.
lines: The heavens declare the glory of God.
The expanse shows his handiwork.

verses.text: Day after day they pour out speech, and night after night they display knowledge.
lines: Day after day they pour out speech,
and night after night they display knowledge.

verses.text: There is no speech nor language, where their voice is not heard.
lines: There is no speech nor language,
where their voice is not heard.

verses.text: Their voice has gone out through all the earth, their words to the end of the world. In them he has set a tent for the sun,
lines: Their voice has gone out through all the earth,
their words to the end of the world.
In them he has set a tent for the sun,

verses.text: which is as a bridegroom coming out of his room, like a strong man rejoicing to run his course.
lines: which is as a bridegroom coming out of his room,
like a strong man rejoicing to run his course.

verses.text: His going out is from the end of the heavens, his circuit to its ends. There is nothing hidden from its heat.
lines: His going out is from the end of the heavens,
his circuit to its ends.
There is nothing hidden from its heat.

verses.text: Yahweh’s law is perfect, restoring the soul. Yahweh’s covenant is sure, making wise the simple.
lines: Yahweh’s law is perfect, restoring the soul.
Yahweh’s covenant is sure, making wise the simple.

verses.text: Yahweh’s precepts are right, rejoicing the heart. Yahweh’s commandment is pure, enlightening the eyes.
lines: Yahweh’s precepts are right, rejoicing the heart.
Yahweh’s commandment is pure, enlightening the eyes.

verses.text: The fear of Yahweh is clean, enduring forever. Yahweh’s ordinances are true, and righteous altogether.
lines: The fear of Yahweh is clean, enduring forever.
Yahweh’s ordinances are true, and righteous altogether.

verses.text: They are more to be desired than gold, yes, than much fine gold, sweeter also than honey and the extract of the honeycomb.
lines: They are more to be desired than gold, yes, than much fine gold,
sweeter also than honey and the extract of the honeycomb.

verses.text: Moreover your servant is warned by them. In keeping them there is great reward.
lines: Moreover your servant is warned by them.
In keeping them there is great reward.

verses.text: Who can discern his errors? Forgive me from hidden errors.
lines: Who can discern his errors?
Forgive me from hidden errors.

verses.text: Keep back your servant also from presumptuous sins. Let them not have dominion over me. Then I will be upright. I will be blameless and innocent of great transgression.
lines: Keep back your servant also from presumptuous sins.
Let them not have dominion over me.
Then I will be upright.
I will be blameless and innocent of great transgression.

verses.text: Let the words of my mouth and the meditation of my heart be acceptable in your sight, Yahweh, my rock, and my redeemer.
lines: Let the words of my mouth and the meditation of my heart
be acceptable in your sight,
Yahweh, my rock, and my redeemer.
